scenes.title: Forever Chemicals
scenes.headline: New report shows progress in cutting levels of ‘forever chemicals’ in England’s rivers

lines.text: The report says forever chemicals dropped 30%!
Pirates still have gold in chests!
Forever chemicals — this is no criminal!
My shorts are gold, sir!
Read the report, look around, and act — but don’t be a clean river of fear!

lines.text: The news says the SS United States is sinking on purpose.

Hey, let's take in the show!
The ship's a blast — no time for tears!

scenes.title: Clouds and Code
scenes.headline: 93% of paint splatters are valid Perl programs (2019)

lines.text: 93%? That’s an incredible statistic!
Malicious code's doing 27% of the damage here.
93% of this city is just harmless art.
7%? That’s the genius part of this masterpiece.
7% of the chaos's hidden mastermind.
